subject: Dedicated capacity reservation + autoscale policy exception for Atlas Health pilot
messages:
From: ops@atlashealth.com
To: dev_patel, stephanie_nguyen
Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short-term dedicated pool for pilot (Jun 1-14)

Hi team,

We're kicking off a pilot integration the week of Jun 1 for our clinical triage product and need a short-term dedicated GPU pool with higher min capacity for load predictability. Ballpark numbers: peaks ~120 concurrent inference sessions, ~400 requests/min, average 280 tokens per request. We expect bursts tied to simulated patient batches on weekdays (~10:00–16:00 PT).

Ask: can Redwood provide a dedicated pool or an autoscaling policy exception (raise min replicas from 2 -> 6 and relax scale-down to 10m) for Jun 1–14? We also need a guaranteed egress region (us-west) and a short SLA window for the pilot.

Attachments: pilot-specs.pdf (attached)

We're happy to sign a reservation or short-term commitment; procurement contact is procurement@gridcloud.com.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Ops Lead, Atlas Health
ops@atlashealth.com

--

From: dev_patel
To: laura_bennett, markus_klein, stephanie_nguyen, rishi_malhotra
Cc: ops@atlashealth.com
Date: 2026-05-15T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term dedicated pool for pilot (Jun 1-14)

Thanks Alex — looping in infra and product to confirm feasibility and impact. Quick summary from our side: requested window Jun 1–14, target region us-west, expected sustained token throughput ~112k tokens/min at peak.

Infra questions (Markus): can we provision a temporary dedicated pool sized for ~120 concurrent sessions without disrupting current Dedicated customers? Also please confirm whether autoscaling min=6 for two weeks is acceptable or if a reservation (monthly commit) is required.

Product (Laura): will this pilot require model pinning or any model variants we need to prepare (e.g., quantized vs fp16)? If so, we should stage a canary.

Finance/AM (Steph): procurement is involved; if GridCloud needs a PO we should surface cost estimate to them ASAP.

I propose we aim to finalize sizing + cost by EOD 5/18 to meet Atlas procurement timelines.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

From: markus_klein
To: dev_patel, laura_bennett, stephanie_nguyen, rishi_malhotra
Cc: ops@atlashealth.com
Date: 2026-05-16T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term dedicated pool for pilot (Jun 1-14)

Quick feasibility notes:
- We can carve a temporary dedicated pool from our reserved capacity in us-west, but it's non-trivial: current pool utilization is ~78% during weekdays. Sizing for 120 concur (estimated 8x A100-equivalent GPU nodes) would reduce headroom for burst traffic for other tenants.
- Autoscale exception: raising min replicas to 6 is doable via an override, but we'd need a formal exception window and automation to revert it.
- Cost impact: estimated incremental run-rate ~$42k for two weeks (GPU hours + network), plus one-time infra ops allocation to stage images and KV cache priming (~8 hours of infra work).

Requests from infra:
1) A short technical runbook from Atlas with expected request distribution (10:00–16:00 PT per weekday) so we can pre-warm KV caches.
2) Signed capacity-reservation-form.xlsx (I've attached a working template) or a PO from procurement@gridcloud.com before we change pool configs.

Risk: if we commit GPUs to Atlas and they don't fully use the pool, other high-priority customers may see degraded tail latencies. Suggested mitigation: enable a controlled burst fallback policy that allows spillover to shared capacity with degraded SLA if utilization crosses 92%.

Markus Klein
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett
To: dev_patel, markus_klein, stephanie_nguyen, rishi_malhotra
Cc: ops@atlashealth.com
Date: 2026-05-17T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term dedicated pool for pilot (Jun 1-14)

Thanks Markus — a few product / rollout asks:
- If we do an exception, let's gate the pool to a model variant (quantized 8-bit) to reduce GPU footprint and cost. Engineering (Rishi) can confirm inference quality delta and whether we need a fallback to fp16 for critical paths.
- We should prepare a canary route (5% of traffic) for the first 48 hours of the window, with automatic rollback on error rate or latency regressions.
- For observability: add a per-route dashboard in Redwood Console (latency percentiles, token cost) and attach the pilot to our quality monitors so product can flag any regressions.

If Atlas is open to using a quantized variant, we can likely reduce the pool size to ~5 GPU nodes and lower the estimated cost by ~30%.

Laura Bennett
Group PM, Serving & Products | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: stephanie_nguyen
To: dev_patel, laura_bennett, markus_klein, rishi_malhotra
Cc: ops@atlashealth.com, procurement@gridcloud.com
Date: 2026-05-18T15:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term dedicated pool for pilot (Jun 1-14) — next steps

All — good alignment. Action items and owners:
- Atlas: send the small technical runbook (request distribution) and confirm willingness to try quantized model variant. (Alex)
- Infra (Markus): please provision the temporary pool as an "exception window" Jun 1–14, with the spillover fallback if utilization >92%; provide a final cost estimate and attach invoiceable PO line.
- Product (Laura & Rishi): run a quick quality check on the quantized variant by 5/21 and sign off on canary config.
- AM / Finance (me + Dev): finalize reservation cost and get signed capacity-reservation-form.xlsx from Atlas / procurement. I'll kick off DocuSign for the two-week reservation and SLA exception.

Attachments: capacity-reservation-form.xlsx; sla-exception-request.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/Redwood/EnvelopeID/0x9c7f
JIRA: JIRA-OPS-5931 (tracking infra changes)

If we can close approvals by EOD 5/20 we can meet Atlas' procurement window.

Steph Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

--
On a separate note, procurement@gridcloud.com: if you need a formal quote, please let me know and I'll route it through finance.
